faqs.question: What does 🌀🔥 mean from an ex?
faqs.answer: From an ex 🌀🔥 can read either as reaction to a public post or as a re-open coded signal. The combo is ambiguous in a 1:1 thread.

faqs.question: Is 🌀🔥 cringe?
faqs.answer: 🌀🔥 is rarely cringe inside the right group. Outside it the reaction register can read as performative.

faqs.question: Should I use 🌀🔥 for small things?
faqs.answer: For small things 🌀🔥 reads as too loud. Reach for a single emoji; save the combo for moments that genuinely earned the reaction.

faqs.question: What does 🌀🔥 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: On TikTok 🌀🔥 shows up as a comment-section reaction. The reaction register is universal across audiences.
